observations.behavior: The chunk refactors Snowflake warehouse ingestion, replacing marker-based ownership checks with UUID-based run identification and adding a publish-stamp marker to prevent redundant full-refresh overwrites.
observations.code_quote: return is_published_by(await self._table_comment(client, ctx.table_name), ctx.schema_id, ctx.run_uuid)
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent PostHog warehouse ingestion jobs from re-running full refreshes unnecessarily, potentially saving warehouse credits and reducing latency. The implementation relies on a comment-based marker stored in Snowflake tables, not a database transaction or metadata store, which could be a single point of failure if comments are cleared or corrupted.
